summary.zh: 行动小队系统把成员能力、小队职位、总部位置、地图标记和区域行动连接起来，是玩家主动干预校园局势的核心工具。
summary.en: The action squad system connects member abilities, squad roles, headquarters, map markers, and region actions. It is the player's main tool for active intervention.

items.zh: 玩家可以创建行动小队，并为小队设置队名和队旗。
items.en: The player can create action squads and set their name and flag.

items.zh: 创建小队需要满足名称、成员和队长等条件。
items.en: Creating a squad requires conditions such as a name, members, and a leader.

items.zh: 已创建小队可以编辑成员、职位、队名、队旗，也可以解散。
items.en: Created squads can be edited, renamed, have members and roles changed, change flags, or be disbanded.

items.zh: 小队能力由成员能力平均值形成。
items.en: Squad abilities are formed from the average abilities of members.

items.zh: 压力和信任会影响小队稳定度与实际表现。
items.en: Pressure and trust affect squad stability and practical performance.

items.zh: 小队职位包括队长、宣传员、侦查员和成员。
items.en: Squad positions include leader, propagandist, scout, and member.

items.zh: 分散状态下，成员继续普通学生日程，无法执行区域行动。
items.en: When dispersed, members follow normal student schedules and cannot execute region actions.

items.zh: 集合状态下，小队发挥完整能力，但更容易被注意。
items.en: When assembled, the squad uses full effectiveness but becomes easier to notice.

items.zh: 潜伏状态下，小队行动能力降低，但更适合低调行动。
items.en: When hidden, squad effectiveness is reduced, but discreet actions become safer.

items.zh: 地图缩放到一定比例后会显示行动小队标记。
items.en: Action squad markers appear when the map is zoomed in enough.

items.zh: 分散、集合和潜伏会使用不同形状的队旗标记。
items.en: Dispersed, assembled, and hidden states use different marker shapes.

items.zh: 点击小队标记可打开小队信息面板。
items.en: Clicking a squad marker opens the squad information panel.
